svg.title: Prescribed spin-orbit torque geometry on the unit sphere and Fullmag drive definitions
svg.desc: Panel (a) shows unit magnetization m on S^2, tangent plane T_m S^2, orthogonal damping-like and field-like Gilbert torques, and the single Gilbert-to-explicit RHS conversion. Panel (b) compares SignedScalarDrive and VectorCurrentDrive on an HM/FM bilayer of thickness t_F, illustrating current-reversal invariance of sigma_hat.
svg.text: Prescribed Spin-Orbit Torque: Unit-Sphere Geometry, RHS Mixing, and Authoring Drives
Canonical prescribed_sot.fullmag.v1 local source law (SI constants supplied by backend: e > 0, ℏ, γ_e = γ_0 / μ_0)
Unit sphere S², tangent plane, and Gilbert-to-explicit mixing
HM/FM bilayer thickness and Fullmag drive variants
Gilbert torque basis in Tm​ S²
Ω0​ = γe​ℏ Jsigned​ / (2 e Ms​ tF​)
Gilbert-to-Explicit RHS Conversion (applied once by backends)
Author physical ξDL​, ξFL​ in Python; backends map Tᴳ → (Tᴳ + α m × Tᴳ) / (1 + α²)
TSOT​ = CDL​ m × (σ̂ × m) + CFL​ m × σ̂
Ref inputs: J0​ = -4.0×10¹¹ A/m², Ms​ = 8.0×10⁵ A/m, tF​ = 1.5 nm ⇒ Ω0​ = -1.932×10¹⁰ s⁻¹
Physical HM/FM stack convention (free-layer thickness tF​ is an explicit input)
Not meshed in local prescribed SOT
Timing belongs to the named CurrentTransport source (no separate envelope argument on VectorCurrentDrive).
